name: Reliclear
tagline: Enhance photos, remove backgrounds, and erase objects — one tap on Anna.
description: Reliclear is an Anna Marketplace photo editor: enhance clarity and color, remove the background, or remove a described object from one upload. Built on Anna host upload + image.edit (no local GPU). Chat tools let you #mention the app from conversation. While platform edit is unavailable, Enhance and Remove background can fall back to classical local tools (PIL / optional rembg); Remove object requires Anna photo-edit.
